With our family growing, we’ve reached the point where we need something bigger, so it’s time to find it a new home. We’ve taken great care of it over the years, and we hope its next owner enjoys it just as much as we have.
This is a 2012 Toyota Camry XLE with only 101,000 miles which is super low for its age. We purchased it brand new off the showroom floor with just 13 miles on it, making us the original owners. It’s the V4 model that is a great powerful gas saver.
The vehicle has been garage-kept all of its life and meticulously maintained. All maintenance is up to date, and we still have a complete folder of service records and oil changes every 5,000 miles on the dot. The vehicle has never been involved in an accident, and the clean blue Texas title is in hand.
Being the XLE trim, it comes with plenty of convenient features, including a moonroof, touchscreen navigation system, backup camera, Bluetooth, AUX and USB connectivity, keyless entry and push-button start, power-adjustable seats, cruise control, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, remote trunk release, and more.
The White exterior looks great for its age and gets hand buffed and waxed every year. The beige interior is also in very nice condition and has been well cared for.
The Toyo tires are in excellent shape with plenty of tread remaining, and they are nitrogen-filled. Even the spare tire is still brand new and has never been used.

Our business deals exclusively with vehicles that have been converted for handicap/wheelchair use.  However, we do occasionally take a non-converted vehicle in trade towards one of our vehicles.  When that happens, we normally send them to the dealer auction.  But if we get something that is very clean and well cared for, we're allowed to offer the vehicle for sale to the public.

They have given it their seal of approval so it will come with a 3 month 3,000 mile comprehensive warranty.  Additional coverage is also available if you choose.
This SUV runs and drives fantastic!  I've driven it back and forth from home to work for three days in a row and found everything inside and outside is fully functional and working as intended.  There aren't any squeaks or rattles to be found anywhere on it.  A full sized SUV like this has no problem navigating the rougher roads in San Diego and is a pleasure to drive.  There's an 8 inch infotainment screen in the dash with bluetooth connectivity, three rows of seating, remote locks with remote start as well as a ton of other features and comforts too. Everything works as it should, no leaks, and nothing is broken or in need of repair. Plus, it’s got great features including Goodyear Duratrac tires with only about 10k miles on them and lots of tread for the winter.
